summary: Describes an IANA-maintained registry for IETF standards that use XML-related items such as namespaces, DTDs, schemas and RDF schemas. It is a best current practice document and sets up where those names get recorded.

eli5.summary: A big notebook lists each XML name used in Internet standards so no two groups pick the same one. This explains how that notebook works and who writes in it.

questions: how to register an xml namespace with iana
